subject: Human Evolution
title: Varicose Veins and Gravity
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Varicose Veins and Gravity.

hook.text: Standing upright means all your blood must fight gravity to get from your feet back to your heart.

buildup.text: Leg veins have one-way valves to prevent backflow. When these weaken, blood pools—causing varicose veins.

discovery.text: Quadrupeds rarely get varicose veins because their circulatory system doesn't fight gravity the same way.

twist.text: Hemorrhoids, swollen ankles, and fainting spells are all side effects of pumping blood uphill.

climax.text: Our circulatory system is a quadruped design jury-rigged for vertical posture—and it shows.

punchline.text: Gravity is the hidden cost of standing tall.

quiz.question: Why are varicose veins a byproduct of bipedalism?
options: Blood must fight gravity to return to the heart
